map.基于 Sebumeter 皮脂测量仪数据 (μg/cm²)，评估各区域皮脂分泌水: Assesses sebum secretion levels by region from Sebumeter readings (μg/cm²) and classifies the skin type
map.T区 = (前额 + 鼻部) / 2；U区 = (颊部 + 下颌) / 2；温度: T-zone = (forehead + nose) / 2; U-zone = (cheek + chin) / 2; temperature-corrected mean = overall mean × (1 − (temperature − 25) × 0.01)
map.温度每升高 1 ℃ 皮脂分泌约增 10%，故按标准 25 ℃ 作反向校正。混合型: Sebum secretion rises about 10% per 1°C, so a reverse correction against the standard 25°C is applied. Mixed skin is defined as |T-zone − U-zone| > 60 μg/cm², with the T and U zones characterised separately. Skin type grades: <70 dry, <120 normal, <180 slightly oily, >=180 oily. Used to convert multi-site Sebumeter readings and classify skin type.
map.油痘管理：T 区高值提示加强控油与适度酸类。: Oily and acne-prone skin care: a high T-zone value points to stronger oil control and moderate use of acids.
map.产品测评：控油产品 4 周前后测值对比看是否达标。: Product review: compare oil-control product readings before and after 4 weeks to see whether the target is met.
map.分区护理：T 区高、U 区正常提示分区护肤。: Zoned care: a high T-zone with a normal U-zone points to region-specific skincare.
map.：输入：T 区测值高位、U 区正常 → 判油性分区，建议 T 区控油+水杨酸、U: Input: a high T-zone reading with a normal U-zone → classified as oily/concentrated skin, so control oil and use salicylic acid on the T-zone while moisturising the U-zone without layering them.
map.皮脂高就是脏吗？: Does high sebum mean the skin is dirty?
map.不是。皮脂是正常屏障组成，过高才需管理。: No. Sebum is a normal component of the skin barrier and only needs management when it is too high.
map.受时段、洁面后等待影响，固定条件下测更稳。: It is affected by time of day and by how long you wait after cleansing, so measuring under fixed conditions is more reliable.
map.不能。仅皮脂参考，痤疮请皮肤科。: No. This is a sebum reference only; see a dermatologist for acne.
